description: This Java source file defines a Jersey provider for handling JSON serialization and deserialization using Spring's MappingJackson2HttpMessageConverter. It implements MessageBodyReader and MessageBodyWriter to process HTTP request and response bodies, specifically for JSON content, within a Jersey-based application.

classes.name: JerseyJacksonObjectArgumentHandler
classes.description: A Jersey provider class that enables JSON message body processing by delegating to Spring's Jackson converter, supporting both reading (deserialization) and writing (serialization).

methods.name: isReadable
methods.description: Indicates whether the provider can deserialize a given type; always returns true.

methods.name: readFrom
methods.description: Reads and deserializes the HTTP request body into a Java object, with special handling if the target type is String.

methods.name: isWriteable
methods.description: Indicates whether the provider can serialize a given type; always returns true.

methods.name: writeTo
methods.description: Serializes a Java object into JSON and writes it to the HTTP response body, with special handling if the object is a String.
